verdict.rationale: Veo is a video generation model offered through Gemini, Flow and the Gemini API. A video-generation service could plausibly offer scheduled or background workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only interactive generation and multi-turn refinement via the Interactions API. It shows no automations, recurring schedules or autonomous background runs, and the 'Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform' mention is a host-platform migration note, not a Veo capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
